"""INACTIVE source proposal: bounded owner-requested HA reads for native visual data.

No startup/Thin/route imports this module. Only the existing conversation model may
request research; this module never interprets a question, creates model calls,
changes conversation state or gains write authority. Admission needs a separately
reviewed startup policy and real HA helper/schema/cost receipts.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import copy
import hashlib
import json
import math
import secrets
import time
from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any

from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator

from .podview_enrichment import RequestAllowance
from .podview_receipts import _weather_result
from .podview_weather import MAX_RETRIEVAL_AGE_S, weather_projection

READS = frozenset({"google_web_sogning", "HassGetWeather", "weather_forecast"})
MAX_RESULT_BYTES = 16_384


def _text(value: object, maximum: int) -> bool:
    return type(value) is str and 0 < len(value.strip()) <= maximum


def _safe(current: Callable[[], bool]) -> bool:
    try:
        return current() is True
    except Exception:
        return False


def _encoded(value: object, maximum: int) -> bytes:
    raw = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
    if len(raw) > maximum:
        raise ValueError("oversize source")
    return raw


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ResearchPolicy:
    """Independent source allowance; does not read the approved visual20 policy."""

    tools: frozenset[str]
    # Google helper pricing must be verified and capped outside this adapter.
    # A numerical cost ceiling alone cannot bound an unbounded HA agent loop.
    bounded_web_helper_verified: bool = False
    web_max_cost_micro_usd: int | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if type(self.tools) is not frozenset or not self.tools or not self.tools <= READS:
            raise ValueError("only exact reviewed read tools")
        if "HassGetWeather" in self.tools and "weather_forecast" in self.tools:
            raise ValueError("one weather owner")
        if "google_web_sogning" in self.tools and (
            self.bounded_web_helper_verified is not True
            or type(self.web_max_cost_micro_usd) is not int
            or not 0 < self.web_max_cost_micro_usd <= 50_000
        ):
            raise ValueError("web requires verified per-call helper bound")


@dataclass(frozen=True, eq=False)
class ResearchBinding:
    """Constructed by Thin at a trusted current-turn edge, never browser/model JSON."""

    owner: object
    room: str
    session: str
    session_epoch: float
    turn: str
    generation: int
    task: str
    input_revision: int
    answer_revision: int

    def valid(self) -> bool:
        return (
            self.owner is not None
            and all(_text(v, 160) for v in (self.room, self.session, self.turn, self.task))
            and type(self.session_epoch) in (float, int)
            and math.isfinite(self.session_epoch)
            and self.session_epoch >= 0
            and all(
                type(v) is int and v >= 0
                for v in (self.generation, self.input_revision, self.answer_revision)
            )
        )


class OwnerReadAdapter:
    """Reuse current native MCP transport without ToolRouter's voice dispatch lock.

    Exact admitted declarations, assist-owner endpoint and owner epochs are captured.
    No discovery/initialize/recovery is requested; MCP send gets the currency guard.
    A same-content discovery replacement revokes cached/in-flight reads too.
    """

    def __init__(self, router: Any) -> None:
        self.router = router
        self.owner = router._mcp
        self.discovery = router._discovery
        self.epoch = router._mcp_epoch
        self.endpoint = getattr(self.owner, "url", None)
        self._declarations = _encoded(self.discovery.mcp_tools, 98_304)

    def current(self) -> bool:
        r, d, o = self.router, self.discovery, self.owner
        try:
            if _encoded(d.mcp_tools, 98_304) != self._declarations:
                return False
        except Exception:
            return False
        return bool(
            r._mcp is o
            and r._discovery is d
            and r._mcp_epoch == self.epoch
            and o is not None
            and o.initialized
            and o.url == self.endpoint
            and d.retry_state == "ready"
            and d.api_id == "assist"
            and r._mcp_api_id(o) == "assist"
            and d.endpoint == r._safe_endpoint(o.url)
        )

    def declaration(self, tool: str, args: dict) -> dict | None:
        if tool not in READS or not self.current():
            return None
        # A model may pick real arguments; it cannot broaden their key vocabulary.
        if tool == "google_web_sogning":
            if set(args) != {"query"} or not _text(args.get("query"), 240):
                return None
        elif args:
            return None  # default home read only; no invented location or entity
        rows = [
            d
            for d in self.discovery.mcp_tools
            if d.get("name") == tool and tool in self.discovery.mcp_names
        ]
        if len(rows) != 1:
            return None
        if tool != "google_web_sogning":
            weather = self.router._podview_weather_declaration()
            if weather is None or weather.get("name") != tool:
                return None
        schema = rows[0].get("parameters")
        try:
            if not isinstance(schema, dict) or not Draft202012Validator(schema).is_valid(args):
                return None
            _encoded(rows[0], 24_576)
        except Exception:
            return None
        return rows[0]

    async def read(self, tool: str, args: dict, *, current: Callable[[], bool]) -> dict:
        from .tools import _mcp_result_to_contract

        declaration = self.declaration(tool, args)
        if declaration is None or not _safe(current):
            return {"ok": False}
        # Copy whole reviewed declaration, not just a name or capability role.
        fingerprint = _encoded(declaration, 24_576)

        def guarded() -> bool:
            fresh = self.declaration(tool, args)
            return bool(
                _safe(current) and fresh is not None and _encoded(fresh, 24_576) == fingerprint
            )

        result = await self.owner.call_tool(tool, copy.deepcopy(args), execution_guard=guarded)
        if not guarded():
            return {"ok": False}
        _encoded(result, MAX_RESULT_BYTES)
        return _mcp_result_to_contract(result)


def extract(tool: str, response: object, *, now: float) -> dict | None:
    """Known source shapes only; copy exact excerpts/forecast fields, never infer."""
    if type(response) is not dict or response.get("ok") is not True:
        return None
    try:
        _encoded(response, MAX_RESULT_BYTES)
        if tool in {"HassGetWeather", "weather_forecast"}:
            observed = weather_projection(_weather_result(response))
            if observed["status"] != "observed":
                return None
            d = observed["data"]
            coverage = copy.deepcopy(d["coverage"])
            original_data = response.get("data")
            original_result = (
                original_data.get("result") if isinstance(original_data, dict) else None
            )
            packed = original_result.get("forecast") if isinstance(original_result, dict) else None
            if isinstance(packed, dict):
                # _weather_result validated every packed metadata field before
                # weather_projection decoded it; decoding must not erase loss.
                coverage = {
                    "totalRows": packed["total_rows"],
                    "returnedRows": packed["returned_rows"],
                    "truncated": packed["truncated"],
                    "start": packed["coverage_start"],
                    "end": packed["coverage_end"],
                }
            expiry = datetime.fromisoformat(d["retrievedAt"]).timestamp() + MAX_RETRIEVAL_AGE_S
            events: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
            for row in d["forecast"]:
                if datetime.fromisoformat(row["datetime"]).timestamp() < now:
                    continue
                if len(events) == 8:
                    break
                details = []
                # This owner's closed projection omits templow; never create a range.
                for key, unit in (
                    ("temperature", d["units"]["temperature"]),
                    ("precipitation_probability", "%"),
                    ("precipitation", d["units"]["precipitation"]),
                    ("wind_speed", d["units"]["windSpeed"]),
                ):
                    if key in row:
                        label = {
                            "temperature": "Temperatur",
                            "precipitation_probability": "Nedbørsrisiko",
                            "precipitation": "Nedbør",
                            "wind_speed": "Vind",
                        }[key]
                        details.append(f"{label}: {row[key]} {unit}")
                if not details and "condition" not in row:
                    continue
                events.append(
                    {
                        "id": f"period:{len(events)}",
                        "time": row["datetime"],
                        "label": row.get("condition", "Prognose"),
                        "detail": " · ".join(details) or row["condition"],
                        "status": "planned",
                    }
                )
                if len(events[-1]["detail"]) > 240:
                    return None
            if not events or expiry <= now:
                return None
            return {
                "family": "answer-timeline",
                "summary": f"Vejret i {d['location']}",
                "events": events,
                "validUntil": min(expiry, now + 120),
                "provenance": {
                    "kind": "ha_weather",
                    "source": d["source"],
                    "retrievedAt": d["retrievedAt"],
                    "coverage": coverage,
                    "displayedPeriods": len(events),
                    "displayedStart": events[0]["time"],
                    "displayedEnd": events[-1]["time"],
                    "continuousCoverage": False,
                    "forecastType": d["forecastType"],
                },
            }
        if tool != "google_web_sogning":
            return None
        data: Any = response.get("data")
        if type(data) is dict and data.get("success") is True:
            data = data.get("result")
        if type(data) is dict:
            # Exact checked-in HA helper example returns {output: speech.plain.speech}.
            # It supplies no Google evidence URL or image; extra fields are rejected.
            if set(data) != {"output"}:
                return None
            data = data["output"]
        if type(data) in (float, int) and math.isfinite(data):
            data = str(data)
        if not isinstance(data, str) or not _text(data, 1_200):
            return None
        # Native fact-card anatomy supports bounded source excerpts, not invented facts.
        # Split exact consecutive source bytes; no synthetic summary or new claims.
        excerpts = [data[i : i + 80] for i in range(0, len(data), 80)][:6]
        if any(not _text(part, 80) for part in excerpts):
            return None
        return {
            "family": "fact-card",
            "summary": "Resultat fra webopslaget",
            "facts": [
                {
                    "id": f"excerpt:{i}",
                    "label": f"Kildeuddrag {i + 1}",
                    "value": part,
                    "detail": "Webværktøjets tekst · kildelink ikke leveret",
                }
                for i, part in enumerate(excerpts)
            ],
            "sourceText": data,
            "validUntil": now + 120,
            "provenance": {
                "kind": "tool_result",
                "retrievedAt": now,
                "externalSourcesProvided": False,
                "textTruncated": len(data) > 480,
            },
        }
    except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, OverflowError):
        return None


class ResearchOwner:
    """Fire-and-forget owner-scoped work; disabled without an independent policy.

    Each accepted turn is single-use. Timeout/unknown/source error never retries.
    Cache is exact-owner/turn/task/revisions, finite and expires with source currency.
    A cancellation-resistant source task cannot publish or admit another source call.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        adapter: OwnerReadAdapter,
        *,
        policy: ResearchPolicy | None = None,
        allowance: RequestAllowance | None = None,
        clock: Callable[[], float] = time.monotonic,
        wall: Callable[[], float] = time.time,
    ) -> None:
        if allowance is not None and not 0 <= allowance.remaining <= 6:
            raise ValueError("research lifetime allowance is at most six calls")
        self.adapter, self.policy, self.allowance = adapter, policy, allowance
        self.clock, self.wall = clock, wall
        self.closed = False
        self._jobs: set[asyncio.Task] = set()
        self._reads: set[asyncio.Task] = set()
        self._seen: set[tuple] = set()
        self._owners: list[object] = []  # retain identity to prevent id reuse after failure
        self._cache: dict[tuple, dict] = {}
        self._receipts: dict[str, dict] = {}

    @staticmethod
    def _turn(b: ResearchBinding) -> tuple:
        return (
            id(b.owner),
            b.room,
            b.session,
            b.session_epoch,
            b.turn,
            b.generation,
            b.task,
            b.input_revision,
            b.answer_revision,
        )

    def offer(
        self,
        binding: ResearchBinding,
        *,
        tool: str,
        args: dict,
        current: Callable[[], bool],
        publish: Callable[[dict], None],
    ) -> bool:
        # No model/speech/browser awaits this method; exceptions remain optional-local.
        try:
            if (
                self.closed
                or self.policy is None
                or self.allowance is None
                or tool not in self.policy.tools
                or not binding.valid()
                or not _safe(current)
                or self._jobs
                or self._reads
                or self.adapter.declaration(tool, args) is None
            ):
                return False
            encoded = _encoded(args, 512)
            turn = self._turn(binding)
            key = (*turn, tool, hashlib.sha256(encoded).digest())
            cached = self._cache.get(key)
            if cached is not None and self._fresh(cached, current):
                publish(copy.deepcopy(cached["item"]))
                return True  # no tool call, no refreshed timestamps/expiry
            if turn in self._seen or len(self._seen) >= 6:
                return False
            loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
            if not self.allowance.reserve():
                return False
            self._owners.append(binding.owner)
            self._seen.add(turn)  # charged before task launch, including lost/unknown result
            job = loop.create_task(
                self._run(binding, tool, copy.deepcopy(args), key, current, publish)
            )
            self._jobs.add(job)
            job.add_done_callback(self._jobs.discard)
            return True
        except Exception:
            return False

    def _fresh(self, row: dict, current: Callable[[], bool]) -> bool:
        return (
            not self.closed
            and _safe(current)
            and self.adapter.current()
            and self.clock() < row["deadline"]
            and self.wall() < row["validUntil"]
        )

    async def _run(
        self,
        binding: ResearchBinding,
        tool: str,
        args: dict,
        key: tuple,
        current: Callable[[], bool],
        publish: Callable[[dict], None],
    ) -> None:
        deadline = self.clock() + 4

        def live() -> bool:
            return (
                not self.closed
                and self.clock() < deadline
                and _safe(current)
                and self.adapter.current()
            )

        read = None
        try:
            if not live():
                return
            read = asyncio.create_task(self.adapter.read(tool, args, current=live))
            self._reads.add(read)
            read.add_done_callback(self._read_done)
            done, _pending = await asyncio.wait({read}, timeout=4)
            if read not in done:
                read.cancel()
                return
            response = read.result()
            if not live():
                return
            observed_at = self.wall()
            projection = extract(tool, response, now=observed_at)
            if projection is None or not live():
                return
            receipt = secrets.token_hex(16)
            source_id = "source:" + receipt
            family = projection["family"]
            field = "facts" if family == "fact-card" else "events"
            content = {
                "summary": projection["summary"],
                field: [{**row, "sourceId": source_id} for row in projection[field]],
                "sources": [
                    {
                        "id": source_id,
                        "kind": "owner_receipt",
                        "receiptId": receipt,
                        "label": "HA-værktøjets resultat",
                        "scope": "tool_result",
                    }
                ],
            }
            item = {
                "schema": "podview.research.v1",
                "receiptId": receipt,
                "roomId": binding.room,
                "sessionId": binding.session,
                "sessionEpoch": binding.session_epoch,
                "providerGeneration": binding.generation,
                "turnId": binding.turn,
                "taskId": binding.task,
                "inputRevision": binding.input_revision,
                "answerRevision": binding.answer_revision,
                "observedAt": observed_at,
                "validUntil": projection["validUntil"],
                "family": family,
                "displaySuggested": True,
                "provenance": projection["provenance"],
                "content": content,
                "allowedActions": [],
            }
            row = {
                "item": item,
                "deadline": self.clock() + 120,
                "validUntil": projection["validUntil"],
                "current": current,
                "binding": binding,
                "sourceText": projection.get("sourceText"),
            }
            if not live():
                return
            self._cache[key] = row
            self._receipts[receipt] = row
            # finite lifetime source allowance means these stores cannot exceed six.
            publish(copy.deepcopy(item))
        except (Exception, asyncio.CancelledError):
            return
        finally:
            if read is not None and not read.done():
                read.cancel()

    def _read_done(self, read: asyncio.Task) -> None:
        self._reads.discard(read)
        if not read.cancelled():
            read.exception()  # retrieve optional failure, no unhandled background exception

    def source(self, binding: ResearchBinding, receipt: str) -> dict | None:
        row = self._receipts.get(receipt)
        if (
            row is None
            or self._turn(row["binding"]) != self._turn(binding)
            or row["binding"].owner is not binding.owner
            or not self._fresh(row, row["current"])
        ):
            return None
        result = copy.deepcopy(row["item"])
        if row["sourceText"] is not None:
            result["sourceText"] = row["sourceText"]
        return result

    def close(self) -> None:
        self.closed = True
        self._cache.clear()
        self._receipts.clear()
        self._owners.clear()
        for task in (*self._jobs, *self._reads):
            task.cancel()

"""Tool router: model function-calls -> Home Assistant via MCP.

Replaces the hand-rolled REST bridge (ha_tools.py, deleted in Phase 3): instead
of curated service wrappers + a home-grown discovery/allowlist layer, Home
Assistant's own MCP server owns live data and actions. PodVoice admits only reviewed,
uniquely classified tool names from the configured ``assist`` API. Unknown names stay
visible in readiness as pending, but never enter a Realtime session implicitly.

Dispatch never raises: errors fold into ``{"ok": False}`` so the model is never left
waiting.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
import logging
import math
import time
from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, TypedDict

_PODVIEW_MUSIC_SELECT = "podview_music_select_option"

def _mcp_result_to_contract(result: dict) -> dict:
    """Fold an MCP tools/call result into the one flat contract the prompt teaches:
    ``{ok, summary?, data?}`` on success, ``{ok: False, error_kind, error}`` on
    ``isError`` or an explicit structured ``ok: False``. HA script responses may
    wrap that contract in ``{success: True, result: ...}``. JSON text rides in
    ``data``; plain text is the spoken ``summary``."""
    texts = [
        c.get("text", "")
        for c in (result.get("content") or [])
        if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("type") == "text"
    ]
    text = "\n".join(t for t in texts if t).strip()
    if result.get("isError"):
        return {
            "ok": False,
            "error_kind": "tool_error",
            "error": text or "the tool reported an error",
        }
    out: dict = {"ok": True}
    structured = result.get("structuredContent")
    if structured is not None:
        out["data"] = structured
    if text:
        try:
            parsed = json.loads(text)
        except (json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError):
            out["summary"] = text
        else:
            out.setdefault("data", parsed)
    payload = out.get("data")
    if isinstance(payload, dict):
        if (
            "ok" not in payload
            and payload.get("success") is True
            and isinstance(payload.get("result"), dict)
        ):
            payload = payload["result"]
        if payload.get("ok") is False:
            out.update(
                ok=False,
                error_kind="tool_error",
                error=next(
                    (
                        value
                        for value in (payload.get("message"), payload.get("error"))
                        if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip()
                    ),
                    "the tool reported an error",
                ),
            )
    if "summary" not in out and "data" not in out:
        out["empty"] = True
    return out

    async def start(self) -> None:

            log.warning(

    async def _refresh_podconnect_services(self) -> None:
        """Discover PodConnect Control's real HA services.

        HA's MCP surface exposes entities/intents, but response-returning integration
        services are not guaranteed to become MCP tools. PodConnect deliberately ships
        recently_played/top_tracks/liked as REST-callable AI data services, so bridge
        exactly those names — and only advertise ones HA says are installed.
        """
        if not self._token or self._client is None:
            return
        self._services_epoch += 1
        epoch = self._services_epoch
        try:
            async with asyncio.timeout(C.TOOL_TIMEOUT_S):
                response = await self._client.get(
                    f"{C.SUPERVISOR_CORE_API}/services",
                    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {self._token}"},
                )
            response.raise_for_status()
            domains = response.json()
            if isinstance(domains, dict):
                if "services" not in domains:
                    raise ValueError("HA services response has no services list")
                domains = domains["services"]
            if not isinstance(domains, list) or not all(
                isinstance(domain, dict) for domain in domains
            ):
                raise ValueError("HA services response is not a list of objects")
            discovered: set[str] = set()
            target_contracts: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...] = ()
            for domain in domains:
                if domain.get("domain") != "podconnect":
                    continue
                if "services" not in domain:
                    raise ValueError("podconnect services are missing")
                services = domain["services"]
                if not isinstance(services, (dict, list)):
                    raise ValueError("podconnect services are malformed")
                names = services.keys() if isinstance(services, dict) else services
                if not all(isinstance(name, str) and name for name in names):
                    raise ValueError("podconnect service name is malformed")
                discovered = set(names)
                target_contracts = playback_targets.contracts(services)
                break
            # Only the latest service read may publish either domain. A cancelled
            # or delayed older read cannot restore contracts after a newer failure.
            if epoch != self._services_epoch:
                return
            self.timers.discover(domains)
            self._services_retry = None
            snap = self._discovery
            self._discovery = _DiscoverySnapshot(
                generation=snap.generation + 1,
                mcp_tools=snap.mcp_tools,
                mcp_names=snap.mcp_names,
                pending_names=snap.pending_names,
                role_conflicts=snap.role_conflicts,
                podconnect_services=frozenset(discovered),
                fetched_at=snap.fetched_at,
                endpoint=snap.endpoint,
                api_id=snap.api_id,
                server_info=snap.server_info,
                schema_sha256=self._schema_sha256_for(snap.mcp_tools, discovered, target_contracts),
                target_contracts=target_contracts,
                last_error=snap.last_error,
                retry_state=snap.retry_state,
                retry_attempt=snap.retry_attempt,
                retry_delay_s=snap.retry_delay_s,
                next_retry_at=snap.next_retry_at,
            )
            log.info(
                "PodConnect Control data services: %s",
                ", ".join(sorted(discovered)) or "none",
            )
        except Exception as e:
            if epoch != self._services_epoch:
                return
            attempt = self._services_retry[1] + 1 if self._services_retry else 1
            delay = _RECOVERY_BACKOFF_S[min(attempt - 1, len(_RECOVERY_BACKOFF_S) - 1)]
            self._services_retry = (
                f"HA service discovery: {e}"[:500],
                attempt,
                time.time() + delay,
            )
            self._recovery_wakeup.set()
            self.timers.discover([])
            snap = self._discovery
            self._discovery = _DiscoverySnapshot(
                generation=snap.generation + 1,
                mcp_tools=snap.mcp_tools,
                mcp_names=snap.mcp_names,
                pending_names=snap.pending_names,
                role_conflicts=snap.role_conflicts,
                podconnect_services=frozenset(),
                fetched_at=snap.fetched_at,
                endpoint=snap.endpoint,
                api_id=snap.api_id,
                server_info=snap.server_info,
                schema_sha256=self._schema_sha256_for(snap.mcp_tools, frozenset()),
                last_error=snap.last_error,
                retry_state=snap.retry_state,
                retry_attempt=snap.retry_attempt,
                retry_delay_s=snap.retry_delay_s,
                next_retry_at=snap.next_retry_at,
            )
            log.info("PodConnect Control service discovery unavailable: %s", e)

    async def _refresh(self, *, force: bool = False) -> None:
        if self._mcp is None:
            return
        async with self._fetch_lock:
            snap = self._discovery
            if self._mcp_api_id(self._mcp) != "assist":
                self._record_discovery_failure(
                    McpError(
                        "MCP endpoint must target the explicit /api/mcp/assist LLM API",
                        connection_shaped=True,
                    )
                )
                if self._hub is not None:
                    self._hub.set_service("mcp", "down")
                return
            epoch = self._mcp_epoch
            age = time.time() - snap.fetched_at if snap.fetched_at is not None else math.inf
            if not force and snap.mcp_tools and age < _TOOLS_TTL_S:
                return
            try:
                async with asyncio.timeout(C.TOOL_TIMEOUT_S):
                    raw_tools = await self._mcp.list_tools()
                compiled = self._compile_mcp_tools(raw_tools)
                tools, pending, conflicts = self._admit_mcp_tools(compiled)
            except Exception as e:
                failure = (
                    e
                    if isinstance(e, McpError)
                    else McpError(f"MCP declaration admission failed: {e}", connection_shaped=True)
                )
                self._record_discovery_failure(failure)
                if self._hub is not None:
                    self._hub.set_service("mcp", "down")
                log.warning("MCP tools/list failed: %s", e)
                return
            if self._mcp_epoch != epoch:
                log.warning("discarding stale MCP tools/list success after a newer failure")
                return
            names = frozenset(t["name"] for t in tools)
            effective_schema_hash = self._schema_sha256_for(
                tools, self._discovery.podconnect_services, self._discovery.target_contracts
            )
            info = getattr(self._mcp, "server_info", {}) or {}
            self._discovery = _DiscoverySnapshot(
                generation=self._discovery.generation + 1,
                mcp_tools=tuple(tools),
                mcp_names=names,
                pending_names=frozenset(pending),
                role_conflicts=tuple(conflicts),
                podconnect_services=self._discovery.podconnect_services,
                target_contracts=self._discovery.target_contracts,
                fetched_at=time.time(),
                endpoint=self._safe_endpoint(getattr(self._mcp, "url", "")),
                api_id=self._mcp_api_id(self._mcp),
                server_info=dict(info),
                schema_sha256=effective_schema_hash,
                last_error=None,
                retry_state="ready",
                retry_attempt=self._discovery.retry_attempt,
                retry_delay_s=self._discovery.retry_delay_s,
                next_retry_at=self._discovery.next_retry_at,
            )
            # A valid schema is not successful live health. Retain the existing
            # schedule even if the following health request is cancelled.
            if self._discovery.retry_attempt == 0 and self._services_retry is None:
                self._recovery_wakeup.clear()
            if self._hub is not None:
                self._hub.set_service(
                    "mcp", "up" if tools and self._discovery.retry_attempt == 0 else "degraded"
                )
            log.info(
                "MCP assist tools: %d admitted (%s); pending=%s conflicts=%s",
                len(tools),
                ", ".join(sorted(names)) or "none",
                ", ".join(sorted(pending)) or "none",
                ", ".join(conflicts) or "none",
            )

    @staticmethod
    def _compile_mcp_tools(raw_tools: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """Validate the complete declaration page before it can become current."""
        if not isinstance(raw_tools, list):
            raise ValueError("MCP tools/list is not a list")
        if len(raw_tools) > _MAX_MCP_TOOLS:
            raise ValueError(f"MCP tools/list exceeds {_MAX_MCP_TOOLS} tools")
        compiled: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        names: set[str] = set()
        for index, raw in enumerate(raw_tools):
            if not isinstance(raw, dict):
                raise ValueError(f"MCP tool[{index}] is not an object")
            name = raw.get("name")
            if (
                not isinstance(name, str)
                or not name.strip()
                or name != name.strip()
                or name in names
            ):
                raise ValueError(f"MCP tool[{index}] has a missing or duplicate name")
            if name in _RESERVED_PROVIDER_TOOL_NAMES:
                raise ValueError(f"MCP tool {name} collides with a reserved lifecycle tool")
            if "inputSchema" not in raw:
                raise ValueError(f"MCP tool {name} has no inputSchema")
            try:
                schema = json.loads(json.dumps(raw["inputSchema"]))
            except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
                raise ValueError(f"MCP tool {name} inputSchema is not JSON") from exc
            if not isinstance(schema, dict):
                raise ValueError(f"MCP tool {name} has no object inputSchema")
            if ToolRouter._json_depth(schema) > _MAX_MCP_SCHEMA_DEPTH:
                raise ValueError(f"MCP tool {name} schema exceeds depth {_MAX_MCP_SCHEMA_DEPTH}")
            description = raw["description"] if "description" in raw else name
            if not isinstance(description, str):
                raise ValueError(f"MCP tool {name} has a non-string description")
            try:
                Draft202012Validator.check_schema(schema)
            except SchemaError as exc:
                raise ValueError(f"MCP tool {name} has invalid schema: {exc.message}") from exc
            for node in ToolRouter._schema_nodes(schema):
                for keyword in ("$ref", "$dynamicRef"):
                    ref = node.get(keyword)
                    if isinstance(ref, str) and not ref.startswith("#"):
                        raise ValueError(f"MCP tool {name} uses non-local {keyword}")
            Draft202012Validator(schema)
            names.add(name)
            declaration = {
                "name": name,
                "description": description or name,
                "parameters": schema,
            }
            tool_bytes = compact_json_size(realtime_function_tool(declaration))
            if tool_bytes > _MAX_MCP_TOOL_BYTES:
                raise ValueError(f"MCP tool {name} exceeds {_MAX_MCP_TOOL_BYTES} bytes")
            compiled.append(declaration)
            if realtime_tools_wire_size(compiled) > _MAX_MCP_TOTAL_BYTES:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"MCP tools/list exceeds {_MAX_MCP_TOTAL_BYTES} serialized wire bytes"
                )
        return compiled

    @staticmethod
    def _admit_mcp_tools(
        compiled: list[dict[str, Any]],
    ) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], set[str], list[str]]:
        """Admit the reviewed Assist surface; never infer roles from prose.

        ``HassGetWeather`` is the preferred single HA weather owner. The legacy
        ``weather_forecast`` name is admitted only when the preferred tool is absent.
        Every other unknown name remains pending classification and cannot enter a
        Realtime session.
        """
        by_name = {str(tool["name"]): tool for tool in compiled}
        admitted_names = set(by_name).intersection(_TOOL_CAPABILITY_ROLES)
        pending = set(by_name).difference(admitted_names)
        conflicts: list[str] = []

        if "HassGetWeather" in by_name and "weather_forecast" in by_name:
            admitted_names.discard("weather_forecast")
            pending.add("weather_forecast")

        for name, role in _PENDING_ROLE_CANDIDATES.items():
            if name not in by_name:
                continue
            role_owners = {
                admitted_name
                for admitted_name in admitted_names
                if role in _TOOL_CAPABILITY_ROLES[admitted_name]
            }
            if role_owners:
                conflicts.append(f"{role}:{name}")
                admitted_names.difference_update(role_owners)
                pending.update(role_owners)

        admitted = [tool for tool in compiled if tool["name"] in admitted_names]
        return admitted, pending, sorted(conflicts)

    @classmethod
    def _schema_nodes(cls, value: object):
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            yield value
            for child in value.values():
                yield from cls._schema_nodes(child)
        elif isinstance(value, list):
            for child in value:
                yield from cls._schema_nodes(child)

    @classmethod
    def _json_depth(cls, value: object) -> int:
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            return 1 + max((cls._json_depth(child) for child in value.values()), default=0)
        if isinstance(value, list):
            return 1 + max((cls._json_depth(child) for child in value), default=0)
        return 0

    def _record_discovery_failure(self, error: Exception | str) -> None:
        snap = self._discovery
        if isinstance(error, McpError) and error.connection_shaped and self._mcp is not None:
            reset = getattr(self._mcp, "reset_connection_state", None)
            if callable(reset):
                reset()
        self._mcp_epoch += 1
        attempt = snap.retry_attempt + 1
        delay = _RECOVERY_BACKOFF_S[min(attempt - 1, len(_RECOVERY_BACKOFF_S) - 1)]
        self._discovery = _DiscoverySnapshot(
            generation=snap.generation + 1,
            # Active sessions already copied their accepted schema. New sessions get
            # no HA declarations until a complete fresh page is admitted.
            mcp_tools=(),
            mcp_names=frozenset(),
            pending_names=frozenset(),
            role_conflicts=(),
            podconnect_services=frozenset(),
            fetched_at=time.time(),
            endpoint=snap.endpoint,
            api_id=snap.api_id,
            server_info=snap.server_info,
            schema_sha256=None,
            last_error=str(error)[:500],
            retry_state="retrying",
            retry_attempt=attempt,
            retry_delay_s=delay,
            next_retry_at=time.time() + delay,
        )
        self.healthy = False
        if self._hub is not None:
            self._hub.set_service("mcp", "down")
        self._recovery_wakeup.set()

    def next_probe_delay(self) -> float:
        snap = self._discovery
        delay = _TOOLS_TTL_S
        if snap.next_retry_at is not None:
            delay = max(0.0, snap.next_retry_at - time.time())
        if self._services_retry is not None:
            delay = min(delay, max(0.0, self._services_retry[2] - time.time()))
        return delay

    async def wait_for_recovery_signal(self) -> None:
        await self._recovery_wakeup.wait()
        self._recovery_wakeup.clear()

    def discovery_status(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        snap = self._discovery
        status = {
            "generation": snap.generation,
            "fetched_at": snap.fetched_at,
            "endpoint": snap.endpoint,
            "api_id": snap.api_id,
            "server_info": dict(snap.server_info),
            "schema_sha256": (
                self.declaration_schema_sha256()
                if self._device_control.available
                else snap.schema_sha256
            ),
            "pending_tools": sorted(snap.pending_names),
            "role_conflicts": list(snap.role_conflicts),
            "last_error": snap.last_error,
            "retry_state": snap.retry_state,
            "retry_attempt": snap.retry_attempt,
            "retry_delay_s": snap.retry_delay_s,
            "next_retry_at": snap.next_retry_at,
        }
        if self._services_retry is not None and (
            snap.next_retry_at is None or self._services_retry[2] < snap.next_retry_at
        ):
            error, attempt, next_retry_at = self._services_retry
            status.update(
                last_error=error,
                retry_state="retrying",
                retry_attempt=attempt,
                retry_delay_s=_RECOVERY_BACKOFF_S[min(attempt - 1, len(_RECOVERY_BACKOFF_S) - 1)],
                next_retry_at=next_retry_at,
            )
        return status

    @staticmethod
    def _mcp_api_id(mcp: Any) -> str | None:
        endpoint = str(getattr(mcp, "url", "") or "")
        if not endpoint:
            return None
        path = urlsplit(endpoint).path or "/"
        normalized = path.rstrip("/") or "/"
        if normalized in {"/api/mcp/assist", "/core/api/mcp/assist"}:
            return "assist"
        return f"invalid:{normalized}"

    @staticmethod
    def _safe_endpoint(endpoint: Any) -> str | None:
        raw = str(endpoint or "")
        if not raw:
            return None
        try:
            parsed = urlsplit(raw)
            host = parsed.hostname or ""
            if ":" in host:
                host = f"[{host}]"
            netloc = f"{host}:{parsed.port}" if parsed.port is not None else host
        except ValueError:
            return "invalid-configured-endpoint"
        return urlunsplit((parsed.scheme, netloc, parsed.path, "", ""))

    async def probe(self) -> bool:
        """PROVE home control by touching a REAL read-only tool. A tool COUNT lies:
        HassTurnOn/GetLiveContext exist as tools even with ZERO exposed entities
        (modprøve A2 — 'lam men lyder rask'). Called at boot and periodically."""
        # HACS can add/reload Control independently of this add-on. Refresh its
        # services on the same probe edge. A failed current read removes those tools
        # for the next session; an already-open session retains its detached schema.
        await self._refresh_podconnect_services()
        ok = False
        if self._mcp is not None:
            # Admission (complete list + schema compilation) happens before the read-only
            # live-context probe.  A rejected page can never be advertised to Realtime.
            await self._refresh(force=True)
        if (
            self._mcp is not None
            and self._discovery.retry_state == "ready"
            and "GetLiveContext" in self._discovery.mcp_names
        ):
            health_owner = (self._mcp, self._mcp_epoch, self._discovery.generation)
            try:
                r = await self.dispatch("GetLiveContext", {})
                ok = bool(r.get("ok")) and bool(r.get("data") or r.get("summary"))
            except Exception as e:
                log.warning("MCP probe failed: %s", e)
            if health_owner != (self._mcp, self._mcp_epoch, self._discovery.generation) or (
                self._client is not None and self._client.is_closed
            ):
                return False  # Old health cannot publish or retire a newer recovery owner.
            if ok:
                self._discovery = replace(
                    self._discovery, retry_attempt=0, retry_delay_s=None, next_retry_at=None
                )
                if self._services_retry is None:
                    self._recovery_wakeup.clear()
        if ok != self.healthy:
            log.warning("home-control probe: %s", "RECOVERED" if ok else "FAILED (no live context)")
        self.healthy = ok
        if self._hub is not None and self._mcp is not None:
            self._hub.set_service("mcp", "up" if ok else "degraded")
        return ok
